title: mesh-build plugin: what it does and when to call it
when: the STL is ready and must become a usable OpenFOAM volume mesh
statement: mesh-build is a DSH bundle for volume meshes: routes snappy (hex-dominant, layers, multi-region CHT), cfMesh cartesianMesh, gmsh OCC route D, plus a checkMesh-based quality gate for each region. Three tools: mesh_hints (these cards), mesh_build (scaffold a case from an STL, or build an existing case along a route), mesh_check (after meshing: metrics + gate rc; minVol is passed separately and is absolute).
recipe: start with mesh_hints({query}) — traps and quality-improvement recipes
new case: mesh_build({route:'snappy', scaffold:true, caseDir, stl, scaffoldOptions:{domainMin,domainMax,cellSize,locationInMesh}})
existing case: mesh_build({route:'snappy', scaffold:false, caseDir, np:6})
after the build: mesh_check({caseDir, profile:'project', minVol:<h_min³/6>}) — look for PASS in verdict, not in “it built without errors”
evidence: plugins/mesh-build/index.js: mesh_hints, mesh_build, mesh_check; data/engine.json — routes, steps, profiles; lib/skill.js — the agent instruction
verified by a live run: v13_best → PASS at minVol 1e-16 (fluid 331 792 / 18.71°, solid 243 965 / 26.54°); e2e snappy 19.6 s → PASS 27 424 cells / 41.34°

title: Meshing and delivery without sim-project.json
when: mesh_build/mesh_check/mesh_deliver run in a clean directory without a project profile
statement: mesh-build works without a profile: project:"defaults", cases default to ./cases, the gate profile is project, and if the case has no system/fvSchemes|fvSolution the gate synthesises minimal copies in an overlay (it does not affect the metrics, an advisory says so). mesh_deliver no longer requires tools/deliver/make_delivery.sh: when the project script is absent a packaged copy <bundle>/scripts/deliver/make_delivery.sh is used (+ scripts/qa/mesh_gate.sh, region_layout.py), and the gate writes its overlay to MESH_GATE_CACHE_DIR=<outDir>/.gate. Verified in /tmp: 2584 cells, gate PASS, DELIVERED, 1.8 MB of artefacts.
recipe: mesh_check({caseDir:'cases/cube', minVol:<h_min³/6>, profile:'project'}) — look for the verdict in gate.verdict
mesh_deliver({caseDir:'cases/cube', name:'cube', minVol:<same>}) — the signature path: passport → gate → openfoam_<name>/ + .tar.gz + ansys_<name>/ + .zip
OpenFOAM not in PATH: pass openfoam:'/usr/lib/openfoam/openfoam2512/etc/bashrc' (installation ids live in sim-project.json)
need your own caseRoots/thresholds/layers — create sim-project.json: gate.profiles, caseRoots, foam.installations
evidence: plugins/mesh-build/scripts/deliver/make_delivery.sh and scripts/qa/mesh_gate.sh — packaged copies with QA_ROOT from MESH_GATE_CACHE_DIR
plugins/mesh-build/index.js: withPortable() instead of the requireProject gate
run of 2026-11-26 in /tmp: gate PASS 18.29°, DELIVERED, roundtrip ok

title: Patch roles after meshing: retype, never split, then re-check
when: the mesh is built and a solver needs inlet/outlet/walls instead of one snappy wall patch plus a symmetry domain box
statement: snappy on a scaffolded case leaves the obstacle faces and the domain box in two patches: one `wall` and one `symmetry` (`world`). A solver needs flow roles, so the types are retyped in `constant/<region>/polyMesh/boundary` — a documented post-step (in a regional case `changeDictionary` does not work, exp-006/D-013). Retyping changes the type of an existing patch; it cannot split one patch into inlet+outlet, because faces are not re-grouped. For a split, build face sets (`topoSet`) and `createPatch`, or give the geometry named patches before meshing (generator `fluid_patches.stl`, hint channel-named-patches). After any retype the passport is stale: `mesh_check` must run again before delivery.
recipe: mesh_patch_types({ caseDir, dryRun:true, roles:{ inlet:['world'], outlet:['a1-cube'], walls:['obstacle'] } }) — see the diff first
drop dryRun: the tool writes a .bak, edits only the `type` line inside each patch, and updates handoff.json

refusals are deliberate: a missing patch name lists what exists; one patch in two roles; type empty/cyclic cannot become a flow boundary; cyclic/wedge need manual neighbourPatch or wedge geometry; multi-region needs region
recheck:true re-runs the gate and reports sameAsRecorded — patch types cannot change mesh metrics
mesh_check({ caseDir, minVol }) afterwards: the boundary hash changed, so the old passport is stale and mesh_deliver will refuse it
appendix C of the benchmark protocol uses foamDictionary for the same edit — mesh_patch_types is the tool that does it with a diff and the refusals
evidence: plugins/mesh-build/index.js: mesh_patch_types (roles, dryRun, recheck), handoff roles carry-over
experiments/_scratch/verify-a2.mjs: 18/18 — retype, refusals, multi-region, recheck sameAsRecorded (66 241 cells, 24.2346°)
